neighbours.label: the last word before a hard line break in the middle of a sentence (fixed-width wrapped text)
fire:
When we reached the station the train had already left, so we sat on a
bench and waited for the next one to arrive from the city.

The committee met twice in March, but the members could not agree on the
budget, and the chairman postponed the final vote until May.

She opened the letter slowly, afraid of what it might say about her
father, and read it twice before she put it back in the drawer.

In most restaurants you are served bread and water, and with any luck your
table is cleared regularly by an attentive waiter.

The old bridge was closed for repairs, which meant that every truck had to
take the long road through the hills to reach the port.

He thought of her as someone who had tricked him, but the calmer side of
him said she was only trying to help him out.

It should query the original data source and then initialize the local
cache with a base layer of data before serving requests.

The farmers planted their wheat early that year because the spring was
unusually warm and the soil had dried out by April.
